title: Exact augmented free simplex module complex at each component
statement: Let $m\ge 0$ and let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring. For an ordinary $\Lambda$-module $M$ (viewed, when tensored with a sheaf, through the constant coefficient module construction [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]), form the augmented chain complex indexed by the simplex category [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] whose degree-$p$ term is $C_p(m,M)=\bigoplus_{\alpha:[p]\to[m]}M$, whose differential is the alternating sum of the maps carrying the $\alpha$ summand to the $\alpha\delta_i$ summand, and whose augmentation $C_0(m,M)\to M$ folds all summands by the identity. Then this augmented complex $\cdots\to C_2(m,M)\to C_1(m,M)\to C_0(m,M)\to M\to0$ is exact.
